title: The Good Docs Project templates strict overlay v1.1
description: The strict overlay for tgdp:templates:1.1. Stack it beside the open schema, which owns the key and the required rule. It closes `type` to the 25 template slugs and requires no key.

type.description: Stacked beside tgdp:templates:1.1, strict closes `type` to the 25 template slugs. That is the check tgdp:templates:1.0 makes in one file.
